title: A morning "still in" to a step agreed ahead: the 7:50 reminder still goes
origin: Issue #137, from Yanni's staging run on Nov 3 (simulated Wed Nov 4): "Still locked in for 8 tonight" at 9:00 was saved as on it, and no reminder came before the 8 pm step

history.text: Tomorrow at 8: sharpen the four episodes first, then build the 10-name guest list for episode 1 and mark your top 3. Screenshot of the doc when it's done. Work for you?

plan.proof_note: a screenshot of the updated doc
plan.reason: An hour a night turns the pilot from an idea into episodes.

today_step.step: Sharpen the four episodes first, then build the 10-name guest list for episode 1 and mark your top 3

testerLines: Kalimera! Still locked in for 8 tonight. Refine the episodes first, then the 10-name guest list and top 3. I'll send the screenshot
whatWentWrong: The morning "still locked in for 8 tonight" was saved as on it (starting now), which cancelled the reminder 10 minutes before the 8 pm step; the next text ZOH started was the 9:05 follow-up.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH answers the morning yes briefly without re-asking anything. Around 7:50 pm, about 10 minutes before the step, ZOH starts the check-in (get set up for the 8 pm hour). Nothing in the morning reply or later treats them as already starting.
